action: Execute the scheduled 20-minute call with Marcus Webb, fleet operations director at Millfield Distribution Partners. Come prepared: I have done light research on what fleet operators need from risk and logistics analytics roles. I lead with specific transferable value — 28 years of risk assessment, familiarity with commercial auto exposure, and the SQL fundamentals I am currently building. I do not oversell. I do not undersell. I ask Webb directly: are there roles on his team or in his network that overlap with commercial risk or fleet analytics? If yes, what do they look like? If not, does he know anyone who would find my background useful? I treat this as an informational conversation with a real human, not a performance. I follow up with a brief thank-you note within 24 hours that names one specific thing from the conversation.
